purpose: Choose one memory-safe micro-batch size for every corrected Dense no-packing run without using optimizer-quality outcomes.

freeze_context.note: This is a post-diagnosis corrective replication. It is not prospective evidence for the original optimizer hypothesis.

stress_dataset.selection: sort all formal training rows by descending declared length, then ascending sample_id; take the first 256
stress_dataset.role: engineering-only worst-case memory stress; excluded from scientific analysis

memory_selection.pass_rule: Select the first candidate, in declared order, that exits successfully after two optimizer steps and writes an independently_padded completion receipt with no CUDA out-of-memory error.
memory_selection.formal_application: Write the selected micro-batch size into the final locked matrix and use it unchanged for all 12 runs. Keep global batch 128 for every optimizer.
memory_selection.quality_blinding: Training loss, margins, and retrieval metrics from preflight are ineligible for recipe selection or claims.

claim_boundary: The preflight can establish only a common execution schedule. It cannot support any optimizer comparison. The corrected study remains required because the historical packed path is materially batch dependent.
